mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wx_subscribe_record (open_id, bind_id, template_id, auth_type, remain_count, auth_time, send_time, send_status, fail_reason, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{openId}, #{bindId}, #{templateId}, #{authType}, #{remainCount}, #{authTime}, #{sendTime}, #{sendStatus}, #{failReason}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE wx_subscribe_record SET open_id = #{openId}, bind_id = #{bindId}, template_id = #{templateId}, auth_type = #{authType}, remain_count = #{remainCount}, auth_time = #{authTime}, send_time = #{sendTime}, send_status = #{sendStatus}, fail_reason = #{failReason}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, open_id, bind_id, template_id, auth_type, remain_count, auth_time, send_time, send_status, fail_reason, create_time, update_time FROM wx_subscribe_record WHERE open_id = #{openId} AND template_id = #{templateId} AND ( auth_type = 'permanent' OR (auth_type = 'once' AND remain_count > 0) ) ORDER BY auth_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, open_id, bind_id, template_id, auth_type, remain_count, auth_time, send_time, send_status, fail_reason, create_time, update_time FROM wx_subscribe_record WHERE open_id = #{openId} AND template_id = #{templateId} ORDER BY auth_time DESC LIMIT 1
